name: Hackensack Packaging Solutions
old_description: Hackensack Packaging Solutions was founded with a single purpose: to eliminate plastic waste from packaging. With decades of experience and a passion for sustainability, we specialize in delivering high-quality, affordable, and planet-friendly packaging materials. Whether you’re a small café or a global retailer, we’re your eco-partner in progress.
about:
Hackensack Packaging Solutions operates from South Hackensack, New Jersey. The company was founded with a single purpose: to eliminate plastic waste from packaging. While the exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, the business emphasizes decades of experience in sustainable packaging.

The company manufactures and supplies a range of sustainable packaging products, including aluminium containers, clear cups and lids, clear food bags, and clear packing tape. It also provides custom branding services such as logo printing, personalized sizing and design, color variants, and packaging design consultation. Production follows zero-waste manufacturing principles and carbon offset practices, with ISO-compliant production standards.

Hackensack Packaging Solutions serves restaurants, caterers, food businesses, cafés, and retail clients, from small independent cafés to global retailers. The company currently delivers throughout New York and New Jersey and offers samples for most products prior to large orders.

The company differentiates itself through a focus on 100% biodegradable and recyclable materials, competitive pricing with bulk discounts, and eco-certification support. Its mission is to help businesses switch to sustainable solutions without compromising quality or aesthetics.
